page.layout: One text column with two inline figures (a pentagram and a hexagon) set into the text; no marginal notes. Head: page number and running head. Below the figures a centred chapter heading, then one paragraph.

main_text.l: quæ dicitur ὑγίεια id est sanitas Pythagoræ, quia Pythagoras
etiam facilis est constructio: primo enim ducitur circulus;
deinde in isto circulo cætera omnia ita eriguntur,
vt in illo Pentagono Pythagorico b.a.e.d.c.
modo à c & d.ad inferiore circuli

page.notes: Figure labels (pentagram: a, b, c, d, e, F; hexagon: a, b, c, d, e, F, and numerals 1 to 6) are part of the drawings and are not transcribed as text. The Greek word ὑγίεια is set in the printed figure caption; the glyphs were read as printed. The drop-cap H of the final paragraph is read as H followed by Actenus. The word "Incompletā" has a tilde over the a as printed.
